He pressed the note to his chest, climbed the spiral stairs, and lit the lamp a little brighter that night, answering a stranger's hope with his own steady, patient, unwavering light across the dark sea.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯昏黄，照着空荡荡的马路，只有偶尔驶过的出租车划破寂静。便利店的灯光孤独地亮着，店员靠在柜台打盹。远处的高楼轮廓模糊，像沉默的巨人。清洁工开始清扫落叶，扫帚声沙沙作响。天边微微泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟儿还未醒来。这是城市最安静的时刻，白昼的喧嚣尚未开始，夜晚的疲惫刚刚退去。一切都在等待，等待黎明把光洒向这座即将苏醒的城市。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of itself.\n- Like looking into two mirrors facing each other, each reflection contains a smaller reflection inside it.\n- It keeps going until it reaches the tiniest, simplest step, then stops."}
